name: walk: a floor (3 m), a wall at x 2 m and a 300 mm step (from z 0)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openContent('room.scad', 'cube([3000, 3000, 10]); translate([2000, 0, 0]) cube([20, 3000, 1500]); translate([500, 1000, 0]) cube([400, 400, 300]);'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !m.active()?.features?.some((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); return 'ok'; })()

name: walk: the Walkthrough page; gravity lands the eye at its height on the floor; walking stops short of the wall; a low step is climbed; the camera is a perspective eye
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const before = m.viewport.cameraState(); await m.run('walkthrough'); await sleep(300); const e = m.state.editing; const page = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-field="walk.speed"]') && document.querySelector('[data-pm-toggle="walk.gravity"]') && document.querySelector('[data-pm="video.record:view"]')); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('walk.eyeHeight', '1000'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('walk.speed', '1000'); await sleep(100); const w = m.state.editing; w.eye = [1000, 500, 1600]; w.yaw = 0; w.pitch = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) m.walk.advance({}, 0.05); const landed = Math.round(w.eye[2]); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) m.walk.advance({ forward: true }, 0.05); const stopX = Math.round(w.eye[0]); w.eye = [700, 800, 1010]; w.yaw = Math.PI / 2; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) m.walk.advance({ forward: true }, 0.05); const onStep = Math.round(w.eye[2]); const cam = m.viewport.cameraState(); const persp = cam.ortho === false && Math.abs(cam.dir[1] + 1) < 1e-6; await m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); await sleep(100); const back = m.viewport.cameraState(); const restored = Math.abs(back.distance - before.distance) < 1e-6 && back.ortho === before.ortho; return JSON.stringify({ mode: e.mode, page, landed, stopsShort: stopX > 1700 && stopX < 2000, onStep, persp, restored }); })()

name: walk: the walker's view on the floor, looking at the wall (picture)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('walkthrough'); await sleep(200); const w = m.state.editing; w.eye = [300, 200, 1010]; w.yaw = 0.9; w.pitch = -0.3; m.walk.advance({}, 0); await sleep(300); return m.state.editing?.mode; })()

name: walk: the W key held walks forward; drag looks round; flying with gravity off goes up with E
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const w = m.state.editing; w.eye = [1000, 1500, 1010]; w.yaw = 0; w.pitch = 0; m.walk.advance({}, 0); const x0 = w.eye[0]; const cv = m.viewport.canvas; cv.focus(); cv.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyW', key: 'w', bubbles: true })); await sleep(400); cv.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'KeyW', key: 'w', bubbles: true })); await sleep(100); const walked = w.eye[0] - x0; const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = r.left + r.width / 2; const cy = r.top + r.height / 2; const yaw0 = w.yaw; cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { clientX: cx, clientY: cy, button: 0, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: cx + 100, clientY: cy, button: 0, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', { clientX: cx + 100, clientY: cy, button: 0, pointerId: 1, bubbles: true })); const turned = yaw0 - w.yaw; m.actions.pmToggle('walk.gravity', false); const z0 = w.eye[2]; for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) m.walk.advance({ up: true }, 0.05); const rose = Math.round(w.eye[2] - z0); m.actions.pmToggle('walk.gravity', true); await m.actions.acceptEditing(); return JSON.stringify({ walked: walked > 100, turned: turned > 0.2, rose, after: m.state.editing === null }); })()

name: video: the Record Video page; a 1.5 s turntable at 20 fps lasts 1.5 s (frames skipped only when drawing is slow) and the view comes back
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.run('zoomFit'); await sleep(300); await m.run('recordVideo'); await sleep(200); const page = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-set="video.source"][data-value="motion"]') && document.querySelector('[data-pm="video.record:turntable"]') && document.querySelector('[data-pm-field="video.fps"]')); const before = m.viewport.cameraState(); const out = await m.walk.recordVideo({ source: 'turntable', duration: 1.5, fps: 20, turns: 1, keep: true }); const after = m.viewport.cameraState(); const back = before.dir.every((c, i) => Math.abs(c - after.dir[i]) < 1e-9); return JSON.stringify({ page, frames: out.frames >= 8 && out.frames <= 31, seconds: Math.abs(out.seconds - 1.5) < 0.2, bytes: out.blob.size > 2000, type: /^video\/(mp4|webm)/.test(out.mime), back }); })()

name: video: 720p live view saved as a file (MP4 or WebM) — the drawing size comes back after
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const w0 = m.viewport.width; let got = null; await m.actions.withExportSink(async (name, type, content) => { got = { name, type, size: content.size }; return true; }, () => m.walk.recordVideo({ source: 'view', duration: 1, fps: 15, res: '720' })); return JSON.stringify({ named: /-view\.(mp4|webm)$/.test(got?.name ?? ''), big: (got?.size ?? 0) > 2000, size: m.viewport.width === w0 }); })()

name: video: the slider-crank motion study recorded (the crank moves between frames)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('asmSliderCrank'); await sleep(1500); await m.run('recordVideo'); await sleep(200); m.actions.pmSet('video.source', 'motion'); await sleep(100); const mats = new Set(); const orig = m.viewport.setBodyMatrix.bind(m.viewport); m.viewport.setBodyMatrix = (k, mx) => { mats.add(k + ':' + mx.elements.map((v) => v.toFixed(2)).join(',')); return orig(k, mx); }; const out = await m.walk.recordVideo({ source: 'motion', duration: 1, fps: 10, keep: true }); m.viewport.setBodyMatrix = orig; m.actions.pmSet('video.source', 'turntable'); await m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); return JSON.stringify({ frames: (out?.frames ?? 0) >= 4 && out.frames <= 11, moved: mats.size > 10, bytes: (out?.blob.size ?? 0) > 1000 }); })()
